title: 8th Annual Gardens Aglow
seo_title: 8th Annual Gardens Aglow in Springfield, MO – Nov 27
description: The 8th Annual Gardens Aglow takes place on Friday, November 27, 2026 at 5:00 PM at Mizumoto Japanese Stroll Garden, 2400 S Scenic in Springfield, MO. This outdoor event is open to a general audience and is a chance to spend an evening out in the garden.
